display_long_description:
Welcome to the party-platformer battle royal where your hands control the action! Master intuitive gestures to double jump, glide, and interact across dynamic arenas. Race, outsmart, and outlast others across multiple modes—Challenge, Competitive, and Party—with more coming soon. Progress through a rewarding system of levels, quests, and ranking as you play.

[media]
🏆 Physics-Driven Worlds: Every item reacts in real-time. Swing from chandeliers, launch with springs, ride carts, trigger traps, and tilt seesaws—use the environment to win! 
[media]
🏆 Team Up or Stand Out: Play with friends or rivals. In competitive modes, cooperate but fight to be the finisher. Supports up to 30 players per match. 
[media]
🏆 Express Yourself: Customize your character and share your style with the community. UGC features will roll out over time—create, share, and shine. 

Perfect for parties and quick sessions, this game brings people together through laughter, competition, and shared moments.
Early Access launches with Lobby and Match modes. Additional experiences will be added in future updates.
